question: Select the correct pair of semi-metals amongst the following elements.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silicon and germanium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical elements known as **semimetals** or **metalloids** are those that share characteristics with both **metals** and **nonmetals**.
 
• **Important semiconductors and metalloids** are frequently utilized in computers and other electrical devices.
 
• **Boron**, **Silicon**, **Germanium**, **Arsenic**, **Antimony**, **Tellurium**, **Polonium**, and **Tennessine** are examples of semimetals.
 
• Metalloids are often solids that have a shiny appearance and are brittle. They function as insulators while they are at room temperature, but transform into conductors when they are heated or mixed with other elements.
 
• On the periodic table, metalloids are arranged in a **zigzag pattern** between **boron** and **aluminum** and continue down to **polonium** and **astatine**.
